message.content:
Here’s a classic set of ingredients you’ll typically find on hand when making traditional Italian lasagna:

| Category | Ingredient | Typical Amount |
|----------|------------|----------------|
| **Pasta** | Lasagna sheets (no‑boil or regular) | About 9–12 sheets per layer |
| **Meat Sauce** | Ground beef (or mix with pork) | 1 lb (≈450 g) |
| | Onion, finely chopped | ½ cup |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 cloves |
| | Canned crushed tomatoes | 28 oz (800 ml) |
| | Tomato paste | 2 tbsp |
| | Olive oil | 1–2 tbsp |
| | Salt & pepper | To taste |
| | Dried oregano / basil | 1 tsp each |
| | Red wine (optional) | ¼ cup |
| | Fresh parsley or basil (for garnish) | A handful |
| **Cheese Layer** | Ricotta cheese | 15–20 oz (425–570 g) |
| | Mozzarella cheese, shredded | 8–10 oz (225–280 g) |
| | Parmesan cheese, grated | ¾–1 cup (75–100 g) |
| | Egg (helps bind ricotta mixture) | 1 egg (optional) |
| | Nutmeg (a pinch, optional) | – |
| **Béchamel Sauce** *(if using)* | Butter | 4 Tbsp |
| | All-purpose flour | ⅓ cup |
| | Milk | 4 cups (960 ml) |
| | Pinch salt & nutmeg | – |

### Optional Extras:
* Sautéed mushrooms or spinach mixed into the meat sauce  
* Sun-dried tomatoes or roasted red peppers for extra flavor  
* Extra herbs like thyme or bay leaves during simmer  

With this lineup, you’re ready to assemble layers—pasta → meat sauce → béchamel/ricotta blend → mozzarella + parmesan—and bake until bubbly and golden!
